data.description:
## Summary
A per-mutation HTTP 404 against a deleted Jira issue propagates out of reconcile_once and aborts the whole reconciliation pass (exit 1), instead of soft-failing that single mutation.

## Evidence
Live GHA Action run 27023829257 (2026-06-05, first run post-chunk-12):
```
RECON: batch_outcome action=update key=DIG-5305 ...
ERROR: reconcile_once raised: HTTP Error 404: Not Found
##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.
```
Hundreds of updates processed cleanly, then the pass aborted immediately after the DIG-5305 batch_outcome line. DIG-5305 is a deleted probe ticket with a stale binding (1e08 class).

## Root cause
In applier.update_one, an outbound 'update' mutation routes status changes through transition_issue (REST POST /transitions) and priority through update_priority (REST PUT) in acli-integration.py. Both raise a RAW urllib.error.HTTPError on non-2xx — NOT JiraAPIError. The update_one try/except at applier.py:2270 only catches JiraAPIError (illegal-transition 400), so a raw HTTPError 404 (issue gone) escapes update_one -> _apply_batch's update branch -> reconcile_once -> fatal exit 1.

Exact raising call: client.update_issue at plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py:2269 (via _call_with_retry), whose REST sub-calls (transition_issue / update_priority in acli-integration.py:746,847) raise urllib.error.HTTPError.

## Expected
A 404 on a single mutation's target (issue gone) is a PER-MUTATION failure: log a WARNING naming the key + 'stale binding (1e08)', record the error in the batch outcome (failed count), and continue the pass. Only 404 is softened; other HTTP errors keep current behavior. Positive-404 evidence feeds the binding-GC design in docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal.md Item 4b. Must never be pass-fatal.

## Fix seam
The per-mutation apply boundary in _apply_batch's action=='update' branch (applier.py:3114-3156) that already produces 'RECON: batch_outcome ... error=' records — mirror the adjacent AssigneeNotFoundError soft-fail handler.

## Repro (RED unit test)
Batch with one good update + one update whose target raises urllib.error.HTTPError(404) (mock client) -> good one applies, pass completes, outcome records the 404; pass exit reflects partial success per existing failed>0 semantics.
data.title: Reconciler: HTTPError 404 on stale-binding update mutation (DIG-5305) aborts entire sync pass
